title: Secure and Functional Code Generation with Self-Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2610.33450v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) can generate functionally correct code that remains insecure. Security-focused fine-tuning can be expensive and is not always available, motivating inference-time approaches. Security-oriented prompting and retrieval can reduce vulnerabilities, but may also remove required behavior or apply defenses incompatible with the task. The challenge is to identify relevant security knowledge and use it to improve security without sacrificing functionality. We present SecGent, an inference-time framework that retrieves weakness context from the Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) database and applies it to secure code generation. By connecting task specifications to relevant textual CWE records, SecGent provides task-specific security guidance without relying on retrieved vulnerable or patched code examples. translated_title: 基于自我评估的安全且功能正确的代码生成
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）能够生成功能正确但仍不安全的代码。以安全为核心的微调成本高昂且并非总是可行，这促使人们探索推理时（inference-time）方法。面向安全的提示和检索可以减少漏洞，但也可能移除所需的行为，或应用与任务不兼容的防御措施。挑战在于如何识别相关的安全知识，并利用它在不牺牲功能性的前提下提升安全性。我们提出了SecGent，这是一个推理时框架，它从通用缺陷枚举（CWE）数据库中检索弱点上下文并将其应用于安全代码生成。通过将任务规范与相关的CWE文本记录关联起来，SecGent提供针对特定任务的安全指导，而无需依赖检索到的易受攻击或已修补的代码示例。互补的功能测试和安全测试对生成的实现进行检查，其执行反馈指导……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: SecGent是一个推理时框架，通过从CWE数据库检索弱点上下文提供任务特定的安全指导，并结合功能与安全测试的自我评估反馈，在不牺牲代码功能性的前提下提升生成代码的安全性。
en_tdlr: SecGent is an inference-time framework that retrieves weakness context from the CWE database to provide task-specific security guidance, and uses complementary functional and security tests with self-evaluation to improve the security of generated code without sacrificing functionality.
